summary: Alaska State Troopers report a domestic violence arrest in the Goldstream area north of Fairbanks on Saturday night and criminal summonses after a traffic stop on the Richardson Highway. Fairbanks Police report two trespass arrests at the same block of South University Avenue on Saturday afternoon. Nothing has been reported for Sunday by either agency. The Alaska Court System's weekly charges report for Nov. 15-21 lists 36 criminal cases filed at Fairbanks and none at Nenana, Healy or Delta Junction; two of the Fairbanks case numbers it prints, 4FA-26-02316CR and 4FA-26-02317CR, cannot be retrieved from the court's public case database by number or by name.

entries.title: Domestic violence arrest near Goldstream
body: A man was arrested on domestic violence charges at a residence in the Goldstream area north of Fairbanks on the evening of Nov. 21 and was remanded to the Fairbanks Correctional Center. Troopers have not released his name.

Troopers say they were called to the residence at about 9:03 p.m. for a report of a domestic violence assault and that their investigation found the man had committed multiple domestic violence crimes. No court file carrying these charges had been opened as of Sunday morning. Trooper case AK26114935.

entries.title: Driving on a revoked license: summonses after Richardson Highway stop
body: A driver was issued criminal summonses for driving while license revoked and for failing to install a court-ordered ignition interlock device after a traffic stop on the Richardson Highway near the Badger Road 1 exit on Nov. 21. Troopers have not released the driver's name. Driving while license revoked means operating a vehicle after a court or the state has taken the license away.

Troopers say they stopped the vehicle after observing it travel 73 mph in a 60 mph zone, that the license was revoked, that the required interlock device had not been installed, and that no proof of insurance was produced. The vehicle was released to a licensed driver. A summons requires a court appearance; no arrest was made. Trooper case AK26114750.

entries.title: Trespass arrest: Frederick Trent Mayo
body: Frederick Trent Mayo, 56, was arrested on charges of criminal trespass in the second degree and violating a condition of release, both recorded by police as misdemeanors. Criminal trespass in the second degree means entering or remaining unlawfully on premises.
1300 block of South University Avenue, Fairbanks, Nov. 21 at 3:30 p.m.; Fairbanks Police. Case 26003536. No court file carrying these charges had been opened as of Sunday morning.
